items.headline: AI chip selloff: Nasdaq down 5.5%, AMD down 17%
items.summary: Thursday was the S&P 500's worst day since April 2025 at -4.4%, with Nvidia off 9.3%, Micron 17.5% and the main semiconductor ETF more than 12%, its worst since March 2020. Separately, Reuters reports about 600,000 Nvidia H200s stuck in Hong Kong awaiting Chinese import approval, which I saw only via a roundup.

items.headline: Voters back data-centre limits as Google commits $17bn to Wyoming
items.summary: Tallies differ, but roughly 33 of 45 local ballot measures restricting development passed on Tuesday, per The Verge's reading of Redbud data, as seen in a digest. Google's first Wyoming site still goes ahead, with a planned 702MW Bloom Energy fuel-cell project with carbon capture.

items.headline: OpenAI names its cyber model: GPT-6 Cyber
items.summary: This is the model behind yesterday's Linux exploit story. OpenAI claims 48.5% on ExploitGym against 32.1% for GPT-5.6 Cyber, plus 81 previously unknown serious Firefox flaws, with access restricted; those are its own numbers, read via a roundup.

items.headline: Moonshot opens the weights on a 2.8-trillion-parameter Kimi
items.summary: Kimi K3.1 Pro landed on Wednesday with 104bn parameters active per token and a 1M-token context, plus same-day support on Nvidia, AMD, Google TPU and Alibaba chips. I read this through a newsletter, not the release itself.

items.headline: ISS power upgrade finished after a tense spacewalk
items.summary: Anil Menon and Joshua Kutryk unrolled the eighth and final new array in a spacewalk of just under seven hours, after a low current reading forced Kutryk to reseat a connector during orbital night. It ends a five-year effort that NASA says adds up to 30% more power.

items.headline: ESCAPADE's Earth flybys now have times
items.summary: The twin Mars probes make closest approach around 10:00 Irish time on Saturday and 11:00 on Monday, each with a burn of about nine minutes. NASA's star charts cover US sites only, so I can't promise a view from Ireland, and it would be telescope-only anyway.

items.headline: Northern Taurids peak next week under dark skies
items.summary: The peak falls on the night of 11-12 November, just after Monday's new moon. Expect only about five meteors an hour at best, though the shower is known for the odd slow fireball; this rests on one preview page.

items.headline: An AI-run biology lab reaches Nature; a $40-a-year HIV shot gets closer
items.summary: AutoDNA ran over 11,000 lab steps across more than 20 instrument types, with code and data public. Dr Reddy's also won tentative FDA approval for a generic twice-yearly lenacapavir for 120 countries, against a US list price of $28,218; I saw both via a newsletter.

items.headline: GOG's first showcase: Galaxy for Linux and a publishing label
items.summary: The Galaxy client comes to Linux in 2027, with beta sign-ups open now, and Retrovibe by GOG starts with five titles including Shardpunk 2. Road Rash and Wing Commander anniversary editions also arrive, but one recap noted no massive game reveals, and neither I read mentioned Witcher or Cyberpunk.

items.headline: Watchlist quiet again
items.summary: I found nothing new on Witcher 4, Cyberpunk 2, Witcher 3 or Borderlands; the newest Witcher item I saw is October's 5.00b patch for Witcher 3. Most big gaming sites wouldn't load today, so this means 'nothing found' rather than 'nothing happened'.

items.headline: The Crown's brackets: Mica opens against Leleo Souza
items.summary: Sunday's invitational in Long Beach pays $20,000 in each of six divisions, with 48 athletes. Also in round one: Murasaki vs Gamba, Sarah Galvão vs Giovanah Oliveira and Gabi Pessanha vs Maria Ruffatto-Gilpin; the brackets date from late October, and FloGrappling lists an 18:00 Irish start.

items.headline: Otherwise quiet
items.summary: I found no fresh grappling news from the last 48 hours, though FloGrappling's news feed and BJJEE wouldn't load. I can't rule out something I missed.

items.headline: UFC Vegas 124 tomorrow: Cortes-Acosta vs Walker
items.summary: Five rounds at heavyweight from the Apex, with prelims at 22:00 and the main card at 01:00 Sunday Irish time. Suarez vs Jandiroba is the co-main and England's Davey Grant faces Elijah Smith; sources disagree on where a couple of bouts sit, and I haven't seen weigh-in results.

items.headline: No Irish news to flag
items.summary: There are no Irish fighters in the card coverage I read, and nothing dated this week turned up on McGregor, Garry or Hughes. Cageside Press, Sherdog and MMA Mania wouldn't load, so treat that as a limited check.

items.headline: Alan Jones, 1980 world champion, dies at 80
items.summary: Williams' first champion died on Wednesday after a brief illness, and the team has paid tribute. He won 12 races from 117 starts; my search found only this one report, so I couldn't confirm it elsewhere.

items.headline: Storms circle Interlagos with Mercedes one result from the title
items.summary: Rain or thunderstorms are forecast all weekend, with a 60-70% shower risk around qualifying and 40-50% at the race start. Mercedes lead Ferrari 630-504 and clinch by outscoring them by three, with their 12 wins settling any tie on countback.

items.headline: Leclerc says he'll talk to Hamilton about Mexico
items.summary: He confirmed a conversation is coming after their opening-lap clash, and pointed to grey areas in the rules. Stewards cut his penalty from 10 seconds to five; he finished fourth behind winner Verstappen and second-placed Hamilton.

items.headline: WEC finale: Corvette close to a first LMGT3 title
items.summary: The #33's Jonny Edgar leads the #92 Manthey Porsche by 18 points going to Monza, with the #8 Toyota 17 clear in Hypercar and 26 available. Practice starts today and the race is at 10:00 Irish on Sunday; there's no GT World Challenge Europe news.
